Mazagon Dock to Build Rs 15,000 Cr Shipyard in Andhra Pradesh

Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL) plans to establish a new greenfield shipyard at Dugarajapatnam in Andhra Pradesh. The project is estimated to cost ₹15,000 crore. This development is part of MDL's expansion and infrastructure development plans.
